name: Gambler
blurb: Reckless risk taker who wagers HP and mana on fate for huge hits.

passive.name: Lucky Streak
passive.text: Build a Streak of up to 3: rolling doubles with Loaded Dice or winning a High Stakes bet adds 1, losing that bet resets it. Winning All In below 3 Streak fills it to 3. At 3 Streak, High Stakes, Card Trick or All In spends it for a stronger effect. Loaded Dice, High Stakes and Card Trick have a 25% chance to go once more.
passive._not: Gambler rework (Ömer 2026-11-18; sayılar PROVİZYON): eski Double or Nothing (spellEcho) yerine Lucky Streak. id double_or_nothing korunur (ağaç satırı, Gallows Pact set satırı 'chance', kayıtlar). chance = 1./2./3. skill tekrar şansı (eski Loaded Dice repeatChance buraya taşındı; All In tekrar etmez), max = seri tavanı.
